title: Linear Algebra for ML
blurb: Build the linear algebra behind ML by hand: vectors and norms, matrix products, solving systems, the major factorisations (LU, QR, Cholesky, SVD, eigen), and then the ML methods that rest on them.
prereq: You should be comfortable writing Python functions and slicing and broadcasting NumPy arrays.
next: Move on to calculus for ML, where these matrix tools turn into gradients and Jacobians, or revisit the ML Maths lessons linked from each problem for the geometric picture.
